t_advice_summary_textbox.text: choose a gnome who will give advice about where to find mushrooms. Tehre will be many different gnomes throughout the game. there will be a multiplyer displayed before each round signifying a multiplication foactor for your points. different colour baskets can mean points are added or deducted.

vb_textbox.text: I found that choosing bigger hats and brighter colours gave quite good results. I got a lot of +35 and +40 point rounds. I also avoided the colour pink.
